contexts.text: (These) two loves... open and form the internal spiritual man...

The natural mind is opened and formed by means of such things as are in the world; and the spiritual mind is opened and formed by means of such things as are in Heaven... (thus) by means of such things as are in the Word... (Thus) unless the spiritual mind is opened and formed by means of truths and goods from the Word, it remains closed; and (then) the natural mind is opened and formed only by means of such things as are in the world... AE 790:5, Further explained. AE 790:6, Further explained.
(Thus) the spiritual mind is opened by, from the Word, abstaining from the doing of evils. (See many more similar passages see Mind.)
